rig_and_locomotion_plan: Root inspects native SK_Mannequin skeleton, exact bone hierarchy, reference pose and blendspace samples. Binary file presence does not prove compatible rest pose.

Open editable OBJ in a DCC at centimeters. Review silhouette; fix mantle shoulder seams, unwrap and retopologize joints before binding. Canonical model front is -Y; explicitly align to inspected mannequin forward axis/rest pose.

Preserve technical source skeleton under a new review namespace. Skin the new body/garments with reviewed shoulder/elbow/wrist weights; do not assume a static OBJ can become skeletal by attaching it to a socket.

Use dedicated skirt/hem deformation bones or reviewed cloth setup for the long tunic, plus mantle shoulder/back weights. Add body collision proxies and evaluate cloth self/inter-body collisions. No cloth solver is included.

Import new skeletal mesh into isolated review folder. Start with original unarmed idle and BS_Idle_Walk_Run only after skeleton compatibility is confirmed or IK retargeting configured. No weapons or combat animation.

Check front/side/back at idle, walk and run; verify foot planting, garment clearance, knees, shoulders, thumb/fingers, headwrap and bounds through complete loops. Current model has no morphs/facial rig.

Bind one pilot actor to existing resident ID pilgrim_eliyahu. Read semantic goal, request a real navigable route and invoke ConfirmArrival only after positional and access validation. Never equate near/far flag or time elapsed with arrival.

Pause simulation and movement together. Persist identity, task index, remaining work and completion memories in versioned save data before claiming save/reload. Add explicit offscreen route semantics without teleporting through restricted geometry.
Profile a single rig, then small unsynchronized groups, with LOD/material reduction and shared animation where appropriate on the RTX2070. Preserve identities independently of actor representation.
